_meta.description: Machine-readable deterministic data-quality rules applied uniformly across ingestion, data-quality scoring and anomaly detection. Defined once here and reused everywhere.

severity_semantics.hard: structurally impossible state; quarantines the record
severity_semantics.soft: suspicious but possibly legitimate; flags for review only

rules.description: current_balance exceeds original_balance, which is impossible under standard amortisation without a documented modification
rules.reason_template: current_balance {current_balance:,.2f} exceeds original_balance {original_balance:,.2f} with no modification_flag

rules.description: current_balance increased month-over-month without a modification flag
rules.reason_template: current_balance rose by {balance_delta:,.2f} versus the prior month without a modification_flag

rules.description: days_past_due is zero while current_status is Delinquent, or non-zero while status is Current
a balance or term field is negative
the loan's reported balance has not changed for 6 or more consecutive months while the loan is active and interest-bearing
rules.reason_template: balance unchanged for {stale_months:.0f} consecutive months while status is '{current_status}'

rules.description: the loan alternated between Current and Delinquent three or more times within a rolling 12-month window
rules.reason_template: status changed {n_transitions:.0f} times in the trailing 12 months, indicating unstable servicer reporting

rules.description: the servicer did not report a delinquency status (DLQ_STATUS = 'XX' or blank) on an active loan
rules.reason_template: delinquency status was not reported by the servicer for this month

rules.description: remaining_term_months exceeds the original loan term
a performance record exists for a month after the loan reached a terminal zero-balance state
rules.reason_template: record dated {reporting_month} occurs after termination on {zero_balance_date}

rules.description: the balance fell by more than 40% in a single month without the loan terminating, which is inconsistent with scheduled amortisation
rules.reason_template: balance fell {balance_drop_pct:.1f}% in one month without a zero-balance termination

rules.description: the secondary servicer feed reports a different status or balance than the primary performance record for the same loan-month
a month is missing from the loan's otherwise continuous monthly reporting sequence
rules.reason_template: gap of {gap_months:.0f} months detected in the monthly reporting sequence
